documentInfo.description: Valid: the analytics module uses secondary prefix 'exp' for http://example.com/common, colliding with the importing model's 'exp' for http://example.com/financials. The importing model declares http://example.com/common under two aliases — 'cmn' and 'common' — which would make implicit resolution ambiguous. Declaring prefixRemap { 'cmn': 'exp' } explicitly selects 'cmn' as the target alias, making re-prefixing deterministic. All exp:* objects from the analytics module are re-prefixed to cmn:* in the compiled result.
